statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic finite n≥0 and finite horizon T≥0, let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n). Write rtime(live(a,z))=a and rtime(stopped)=0. Define the measurable ordered simplex Δ_n(T)={t∈ℝ^n:0<t_1<⋯<t_n<T}; its subtype carries m_n, the comap of product Lebesgue volume along inclusion. For t∈Δ_n(T), put s_0=0,s_i=t_i, z_0=z₀ and z_i=S_rΦ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)) for 1≤i≤n. Define K_n(t)_j=live(s_j,z_j). Define qReal_n(t)=∏_(i=1)^n [λ_r(Φ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1))) exp(−Λ_(z_(i−1))(s_i−s_(i−1)))] and q_n=ofReal(qReal_n). Here the literal Lean definitions use toNNReal on times and elapsed times; these agree with the displayed nonnegative values on the simplex. Let A_n(T) be the abstract-history set in which all n+1 records are live, their read times are strictly increasing, and each postinitial read time is below T. A_n(T) does not itself constrain the initial record time. Set B_n(T)=H_n^(-1)(A_n(T)) and obs_n(w)_i=rtime(H_n(w)_(i+1)); actual H_n(w)_0 is always live(0,z₀). Then Δ_n(T) and A_n(T) are Borel. For fixed n,T, K_n and q_n are jointly Borel in (y,r,z₀,t). For every y,r,z₀, H_n,obs_n and B_n(T) are Borel, and qReal_n(t)≥0 for every simplex point. For every raw w∈B_n(T), there exists t∈Δ_n(T) with t=obs_n(w) and H_n(w)=K_n(t), as complete tagged histories. The exact unnormalized law is (H_n)_*(P restricted to B_n(T))=(K_n)_*(q_n m_n). For every Borel F:Hist_n→[0,∞], ∫_(B_n(T))F(H_n(w))P(dw)=∫_(Δ_n(T))F(K_n(t))q_n(t)m_n(dt). Moreover ∫q_n dm_n=P(B_n(T))≤1. This includes n=0,T=0, zero hazard and extended-valued tests; there is no boundedness, integrability or positive-event-mass assumption. This is the strict first-n-prefix law, without a final survival factor, and is not a raw exact-n event-count law. It is an attributed ASTIS completion of the finite ordered iteration ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), with joint Borel construction from Appendix A.2. The dimension-zero and ENNReal-test extensions are explicit ASTIS extensions. Terminal survival, endpoint/count identification, the full path-functional A.7 expansion, restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation errors, expected costs and full paper/composition remain outside this result.
